subject: ENGLISH 1
description: ICSE 10th English Language: Appropriate Prepositions, Phrasal Verbs, and Correct Verb Forms

questions.question: Fill in the blank with appropriate preposition: The principal will look _____ the matter thoroughly.
questions.explanation: 'Look into' is a phrasal verb meaning to investigate or examine thoroughly.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The old sailor passed _____ peacefully in his sleep last night.
questions.explanation: 'Pass away' is an idiomatic phrasal verb meaning to die peacefully.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She has been studying in this school _____ 2018.
questions.explanation: 'Since' denotes a specific point in time in the past continuing into the present.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If you had informed me earlier, I _____ you.
questions.explanation: Third conditional structure: If + past perfect (had informed), then would have + past participle (would have helped).

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Do not look down _____ those who are less fortunate than you.
questions.explanation: To 'look down upon' someone means to regard them with contempt or feel superior.
